patientFeedback.title: What Parents Share After Treatment
patientFeedback.subtitle: Heartfelt reviews and recovery feedback from parents who brought their children to CareFirst Clinic.

items.name: Simran Gill
items.quote: My 3-year-old daughter woke up struggling to breathe with severe wheezing. We rushed to CareFirst, and the pediatric triage attended to her within 2 minutes. The nebulizer therapy and gentle manner of Dr. Cruz calmed both my terrified child and me. By next morning she was playing happily again.
items.outcome: Full Respiratory Recovery • Zero Hospitalization Trauma

items.name: Rohan & Neha Mehra
items.quote: Our son used to scream at the sight of white coats. CareFirst pediatricians use distraction techniques and painless needles so seamlessly that our son didn't even notice his booster shots. They track his growth percentiles thoroughly at every visit.
items.outcome: Happy Regular Checkups • All Milestones On Track

items.name: Deepika Joshi
items.quote: The pediatric allergy testing finally solved our daughter's chronic skin flares and coughing fits. With their personalized environmental plan and child-safe medication, she has slept through the night for 8 months straight.
items.outcome: Clear Skin • Restful Sleep & Active Sports Participation
